posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
This one 

>

> >

If Countermeasures is in play and an Explosives Wagon is destroyed, Benchmark doesn’t take damage because of the “instead.” Everyone else does, though.

> >

Benchmark should take damage if the Explosive Wagons was destroyed by an effect like Grapplig Hook and was at full health.  It would need to be at 2 or less health when trying to hit Benchmark for that to take affect.

posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked: "Through some Guise shenanigans, The Idealist can end up with Guise cards in her hand..." Can anyone enumerate how this happens? I'm very curious now.
posts.raw: "Through some Guise shenanigans, The Idealist can end up with Guise cards in her hand..." Can anyone enumerate how this happens? I'm very curious now.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Guise takes Focusing Tiara and puts a card from his hand under a Concept in play.
posts.raw: Guise takes Focusing Tiara and puts a card from his hand under a Concept in play.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Or a card from his trash. Either way, Idealist then plays Bored Now to take the cards from under the concept into her hand.
posts.raw: Or a card from his trash. Either way, Idealist then plays Bored Now to take the cards from under the concept into her hand.
